name: Le Méridien Dania Beach at Fort Lauderdale Airport
positioning: Modern Le Méridien hotel in Dania Beach near Fort Lauderdale Airport, with nautical-themed rooms and a heated outdoor pool
best_for: Travelers flying in or out of Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport
Cruise passengers sailing from Port Everglades

facts.text: The hotel is near Fort Lauderdale Airport and close to beaches, Las Olas Boulevard and the Fort Lauderdale Convention Center.
Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport is about 2 miles from the hotel.
The hotel is near the Port Everglades Cruise Port.
Rooms and suites are sleek and minimalist, with plush bedding and skyline views.
The guest rooms have modern nautical decor.
Rooms have a Le Méridien Bed with a Simmons Beautyrest mattress.
The hotel has a heated outdoor pool.
The hotel has a fitness center and a yoga room.
Le Méridien Hub is a modern take on the traditional hotel lobby, a place for guests to gather and connect.
Constellation Cafe has a floor plan that doubles as a map of Fort Lauderdale's canals.
Cabana serves hand-crafted cocktails and Caribbean cuisine.
The hotel has 23,340 square feet of event space.

highlights.text: Constellation Cafe's floor plan doubles as a map of Fort Lauderdale's canals.
Guest rooms have modern nautical decor.
Sleek, minimalist rooms and suites come with plush bedding and skyline views.
A heated outdoor pool, plus a fitness center and a yoga room.
The hotel is near Fort Lauderdale Airport and the Port Everglades Cruise Port.

considerations.text: This is an airport-area hotel, about 2 miles from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes that airport proximity may mean occasional aircraft noise.
